indications.description: Induction treatment of locally advanced stage III–IV non-metastatic head and neck squamous cell carcinoma.

treatment.schedule_summary: Docetaxel 75 mg/m² and cisplatin 100 mg/m² day 1; fluorouracil 1000 mg/m²/day days 1–4 as a continuous 96-hour infusion (source alternative daily 22-hour infusions); every 21 days for 3 induction cycles unless progression/unacceptable toxicity.
treatment.duration_text: 3 induction cycles, then weekly carboplatin chemoradiation

administration.duration_description: continuous 96 hours; alternative daily 22-hour infusions on days 1–4

subsequent_phase.summary: If no progressive disease and adequate marrow function, carboplatin AUC1.5 weekly concomitant with radiotherapy for 7 weeks, beginning 3–8 weeks (day22–56) after the start of induction cycle3; surgery is then considered.
subsequent_phase.source_reference_discrepancy: PDF prints 00322; current Head & Neck catalogue identifies weekly carboplatin AUC1.5 as 00332. Use separately audited current regimen.

action.message: Delay until recovery. Below 25 ×10⁹/L requires the separate docetaxel dose-history pathway.

action.message: Exact ANC 1.5 ×10⁹/L: table permits ≥1.5, but eligibility and complication text require >1.5. Consultant review; do not silently choose either boundary.

action.message: Exact platelets 100 ×10⁹/L is not assigned by the table: >100 proceeds, <100 delays. Eligibility prints 100 without a comparator. Resolve with Consultant; no invented ≤100 delay rule.

rules.explanation: Exact platelets 100 ×10⁹/L is not assigned by the table: >100 proceeds, <100 delays. Eligibility prints 100 without a comparator. Resolve with Consultant; no invented ≤100 delay rule.

action.message: Delay until recovery; source specifies docetaxel 60 mg/m² thereafter. Confirm current dose and avoid escalating an already lower dose.

rules.explanation: Delay until recovery; source specifies docetaxel 60 mg/m² thereafter. Confirm current dose and avoid escalating an already lower dose.

action.message: After recovery from platelets <25 ×10⁹/L / grade 4 thrombocytopenia, reduce docetaxel 75→60 mg/m².

rules.explanation: After recovery from platelets <25 ×10⁹/L / grade 4 thrombocytopenia, reduce docetaxel 75→60 mg/m².

action.message: Severe platelet nadir requires recovery/current-dose review. Source supplies docetaxel 75→60 mg/m²; do not increase a dose already below 60 or infer another reduction.

rules.explanation: Severe platelet nadir requires recovery/current-dose review. Source supplies docetaxel 75→60 mg/m²; do not increase a dose already below 60 or infer another reduction.

action.message: Urgent clinical assessment of febrile neutropenia. Complete event timing, G-CSF, recovery and dose history before choosing the source subsequent-cycle reduction.

rules.explanation: Urgent clinical assessment of febrile neutropenia. Complete event timing, G-CSF, recovery and dose history before choosing the source subsequent-cycle reduction.

action.message: Delay while complicated neutropenia is unresolved. Confirm count and clinical recovery before a subsequent-cycle dose.

rules.explanation: Delay while complicated neutropenia is unresolved. Confirm count and clinical recovery before a subsequent-cycle dose.

action.message: Complicated neutropenia despite G-CSF: recovery is not documented; no restart dose can be assigned.

rules.explanation: Complicated neutropenia despite G-CSF: recovery is not documented; no restart dose can be assigned.

action.message: After recovery, complicated neutropenia despite G-CSF requires docetaxel 75→60 mg/m². Continue G-CSF prophylactic coverage in subsequent cycles.

rules.explanation: After recovery, complicated neutropenia despite G-CSF requires docetaxel 75→60 mg/m². Continue G-CSF prophylactic coverage in subsequent cycles.

rules.explanation: After recovery, a subsequent complicated neutropenia episode requires docetaxel 60→45 mg/m². Continue G-CSF prophylactic coverage in subsequent cycles.

rules.explanation: Confirm recurrence and current docetaxel dose. Source sequence is 75→60 mg/m², then 60→45 mg/m² for subsequent complicated neutropenia; it does not prescribe a further automatic step.

rules.explanation: After complicated neutropenia, source recommends G-CSF coverage in all subsequent cycles (days 6–15 is an example, not a mandatory formulation-specific schedule).

Baseline ANC >1.5 ×10⁹/L; platelet eligibility prints 100 ×10⁹/L without a comparator—consult source/count table

supportive_care.mapping_basis: Highest emetogenic active component and phase-specific NCCP classification.
supportive_care.supportive_medications_label: NCCP antiemetic guidance for high emetogenic risk
supportive_care.docetaxel_dexamethasone: 8 mg orally twice daily for 3 days starting the day before docetaxel; at least 3 doses pre-treatment. If missed, 20 mg IV immediately before treatment may be considered by the prescribing Consultant.
supportive_care.cisplatin_hydration: Required before and after cisplatin, according to local policy and source suggested schedule. Routine furosemide is not recommended unless fluid overload.
supportive_care.gcsf: May be used prophylactically; subsequent-cycle coverage is recommended after complicated neutropenia. Source days 6–15 is an example.

baseline: ECG if cardiac function is compromised
Audiology and creatinine clearance if clinically indicated
DPD phenotype and/or genotype before first fluorouracil unless previously tested
before_each_cycle: History for ototoxicity and sensory neural damage
monitoring.disease_monitoring: Individualised to treatment plan and supervising Consultant; no fixed imaging interval is supplied.
monitoring.dpd_renal_caution: Uracil phenotyping may overdiagnose DPD deficiency in moderate/severe renal impairment; consider genotype.
